improvement_relation.basis: A typed event reuses the existing append-only session history and existing ECI claim-coordination projection.

measurement_basis: committed session-event implementation linked to the bounded rejection projection

outcome.generation_fence: Rejected generation-fenced requests do not append a second event, preserving the caller Store generation precondition.
outcome.idempotency: A repeated rejected request with the same request identity reuses the same event.
outcome.implementation_change: Session.acquire_claim appends lease.acquisition-rejected for supported prepublication eligibility, adoption, conflict, and checkout-validation failures. The event keeps validated repository identity, failure code/category, scope kind, and explicit-versus-omitted branch state; it excludes reason text and checkout paths.
outcome.interpretation_limit: Tests establish event creation, redaction, projection, idempotency, and generation-fence behavior. They do not establish real-world intervention reduction or recurrence.

request.operation: record safe evidence for a prepublication claim rejection

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment session claim transition and ECI claim-coordination projection

related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
